tldr: North Node in House 5: growth through creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and personal expression.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and personal expression. The South Node in House 11 shows the familiar life field: group identity, audience, ideology, or hiding in community. The house axis describes where the growth has to become lived, not just understood. The practice is to let joy and creative risk matter.
business: Growth becomes practical when the person chooses creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and personal expression in the concrete house topics of daily life.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in House 11 can pull the person back toward group identity, audience, ideology, or hiding in community.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node house names the growth field; South Node house names the familiar field. Requires accurate birth time for house placement.
note: Distilled from approved project node source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
